messages:
Maya (Product): Quick heads-up: ACME asked for a compact multimodal summarizer in beta by Friday EOD. Need cross-team blockers + owners so we can commit.
Noah (Eng): Timeline aggressive but we can try if infra/runtime run in parallel. Primary eng risk: API surface for image attachments + graceful degradation path.
Priya (Runtime): Runtime gap: batching/kv cache assumes token-only sequences. For image tokens we need a lightweight tokenization shim and a cache TTL tweak. I can spike a shim but need dedicated GPUs to bench.
Jamal (Infra): I can carve a short-lived dedicated pool (2xA100s or 3xA10g). Which do you prefer? Need estimated CPU, mem, and expected network egress for perf runs.
Priya (Runtime): A10g is fine for functional perf. Perf profile: batch=6, seq tokens ~ 400, one image ~1.5MB. Peak GPU mem ~16-20GB. Network egress minimal; storage only temporary.
Noah (Eng): API contract: POST /v1/summarize with fields {text, images:[url|base64], mode:"compact|verbose"}. Error modes: 415 for bad image, 503 for runtime overload, degrade to text-only with 200 + warning header. I'll draft spec.
Maya (Product): ACME acceptance: 95th pct latency <700ms text-only; multimodal p95 <1.2s; accuracy judged by their rubric (F1 >= 0.82). Also need opt-out for image processing.
Elena (Security): Images are a compliance flag. Must do: no persistent storage, redact EXIF, and HSM-encrypted S3 signed URLs for uploads. Also require a 48h threat review; if not complete, we require a scoped opt-in checklist for customers.
Tomas (Customer Success): ACME signed DPA and will run 1k beta users. They want a rollback plan and a short maintenance window during staging tests.
Noah (Eng): Rollout plan idea: feature-flagged endpoint -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Need runtime fast-fail hook and a global kill-switch at API gateway. Priya can you add fast-fail metrics?
Priya (Runtime): Yes, I'll add a fast-fail that rejects requests > token threshold and a cache-bypass toggle. ETA 36 hours for a safe implementation and unit tests.
Arjun (Observability): Telemetry hooks requested: trace-id per request, p50/p95/p99, token count, image sizes, and a per-feature cost metric. Need a short schema to ingest traces.
Noah (Eng): Also need an e2e test harness (mock ACME payloads, image fixtures). I'll author tests and a perf script.
Jamal (Infra): Provisioning command I'll run for staging (internal-only):
```
terraform apply -var='env=staging' -var='pool=acme-multimodal-beta' -var='gpu_type=A10g' -auto-approve
```
I will also create a restricted subdomain and mTLS certs.
Elena (Security): Interim controls if threat review delayed: 1) image upload TTL = 30s, 2) no analytics export, 3) limited SSO group access. I'll post the checklist by EOD.
Maya (Product): Action items recap:
- Elena: threat checklist + mitigation confirmation (security) 16h
- Jamal: staging GPU pool + internal endpoint + mTLS (infra)  tonight
- Priya: tokenization shim + cache TTL change + fast-fail + unit tests (runtime) 6h
- Noah: API contract + e2e tests + perf harness (eng) 8h
- Arjun: telemetry schema + dashboards for p95/p99/cost (observability)  days
- Tomas: confirm ACME beta window + rollback criteria (CS) 
 today
Noah (Eng): Also flag: quantization profile differences might affect quality. If we need model variants, we should pin a quantized and a full-precision variant for fallback. That affects infra footprint.
Jamal (Infra): Noted. If we pin a full-precision fallback, add +30% memory budget. I'll include that in the terraform variables.
Tomas (Customer Success): I'll schedule the ACME kickoff for tomorrow 9:30am PT and circulate their acceptance cases and sample images.
deploy-bot: Staging host created: https://staging.acme.redwood.internal/multimodal-beta (mTLS enabled).
Noah (Eng): I'll post the initial API spec in this thread and open a small PR with test fixtures. If any blocker emerges, propose an ad-hoc 15m standup.
Maya (Product): Thanks team. If we keep to these owners and surfaces, we can decide Friday morning whether to proceed. :white_check_mark:
